# Churchtown Media

> Advisory practice of Damian Roche. Consultation on the UK public record, using Institrace and the method developed in public at SIBA Digital. Based in Churchtown, Southport.

## About

Churchtown Media is a consultation practice, not a web design or SEO agency. Damian Roche founded the firm. The public method is SIBA Digital. The joined public-records index is Institrace. Time on a question is what is sold here.

Local editorial sites on the Sefton Coast are separate from this practice.

## What this site is

- Consultation: time on a defined question, using the public record
- A door to commissioned audits at SIBA Digital
- A door to self-serve login at Institrace

## What this site is not

- Web design, SEO retainers, or small-business website packages
- A free audit offer
- Case studies of agency client work
